title: Pulsar Telos LRF XP50 Thermal Monocular
description: The Pulsar Telos LRF XP50 thermal monocular features an all new design. This includes an inbuilt 1000m LRF system and extreme sensitivity 640×480 18mk netD sensor. First our new concept  an upgradable thermal imaging monocular line  Telos by Pulsar. This starts with the Telos LRF XP50 followed by its version without the LRF as well as a number of different sensor models. Telos is designed to be timeless. It is the first line of thermal imaging devices on the market offering the option of technical upgrades. Become a Telos owner and you will have the chance to improve your device in the future and always have a product that is relevant and cost effective. For us Telos is synonymous with superior quality and timeless solutions. The first to represent the new line is the Telos LRF XP50 equipped with the best European-made Lynred sensor with a 640x480 pixel resolution @17 microns pixel pitch. title: Hunters Element Zenith Hood - Desolve Veil / Small
description: If youre venturing on mid-winter alpine excursions or warm spring/summer missions the all-purpose, all-season, Zenith Hood is an essential hunting mid-layer top. An integrated slimline hood has a skull cap design, providing complete insulation without any uncomfortable bulk when paired with a barrier layer. In particularly cold conditions, you can lose up to 50% of your body heat through your head. Being able to retain body heat and transfer moisture is key to staying safe in the mountains. A body-mapped design for the ultimate in warmth, wicking & breathability. Designed as a super packable option for when the weather takes an unexpected turn or for use when things cool down or get wet. The Halo Jacket packs down incredibly small and weighs next to nothing, so you will barely notice its sitting in the bottom of your pack. But when its needed, its extremely waterproof and breathable, just like your traditionally heavier and bulkier work-horse rain layer. Unlike a lot of backup style rainwear, the Halo was designed with all the important features you still need including a longer cut jacket, athletic shape, multiple pockets, sculpted hood and many more. It packs down tiny into its own pocket when not in use so itll disappear into the bottom of your pack. 25,000mm waterproof rating. 10,000gm/m2/24hr breathability rating. Weight Sz M: 525 grams. Waterproof and breathable 3 layer fabric. Half-length zip with domed storm flap. Seam-sealed. Fixed Hood with TunnelTECH hood and peripheral vision adjustments with one-touch pullers. Large chest pocket. Velcro cuff adjusters. When packed down, belt loops allow you to attach it to any belt or strap. Seamless shoulders.

title: Hunters Element Legacy Jacket Desolve Veil - Small
description: The Legacy is the brainchild of the Hunters Element head product designer. He wanted to create the ultimate mid/outer layer that could be used on just about every hunt. The Legacy was made to keep you warm while glassing and stalking without overheating, as so often happens with membrane-lined outer layers. The purpose-built 290gsm Hydrafuse HYBRIDTECH, RPET recycled fabric uses a 90gsm water-resistant, two-way stretch outer with a 200gsm fleece inner. This means that the jacket is really warm but breathes exceptionally well, all the while remaining quiet, soft and blocking out about 90% of the wind. This RPET fabric is made from 100% recycled polyethylene terephthalate (Plastic Bottles). This is just as durable as virgin fabric but saves 29 bottles from ending up in the landfill. He then took every top-quality feature he could find and packed them into the jacket. This includes high-quality zips, a fold-away TunnelTECH hood, zippered slim-lined chest and lower pockets with hand warmers, and premium cuff adjusters. Weight Sz M: 850g Cuts wind Detachable TunnelTECH hood which can also be folded away into the collar Highly breathable wind/water-resistant, recyclable, Hydrafuse HYBRIDTECH 2-way stretch fabric; made from recycled polyester. Full-length front YKK® zip Chest pocket Adjustable Velcro cuffs Waist drawstring PFC free DWR Zippered handwarmer pockets Sizes XS-4XL (Desolve® Veil Camo & Forest Green/Grey to 7XL) Available in Desolve® Veil Camo, Forest Green/Grey, Black or Tussock

title: Hunters Element Prowl Boot - 7
description: The Prowl is a premium stalking boot with a revolutionary knitted design. Built for the forest floor where weight and feel are paramount, the Prowl still performs extremely well in a wide variety of hunting environments. New technology now allows us to create the boot's main body out of a single piece of knitted fabric, the benefits of this are significant. The first advantage of a single-piece upper is durability. Seams and stitching points are always the weakest link in the chain, so immediately these can be dramatically minimized, this also reduces weight and bulk. Additionally, this knitted material conforms to your foot shape for increased comfort. This construction method also allows the main body of the boot to be made from an incredible fabric. The new Hydrafuse Xfyre woven nylon fabric is highly abrasion resistant, flexible, and significantly lighter than leather, especially when wet. This core body is then able to be wrapped in a super-light, ultra-durable TPU bonded web overlay, and full rand, which creates additional structure to the shape and ramps up the durability even more. On the inside of the Xfyre  is a Hydrafuse  REINsoc waterproof/breathable membrane, covered in foot-mapped foam padding for amazing comfort and support. On the bottom of the Prowl is a Vibram® Inverness sole, this sole provides superb traction on slippery and soft surfaces with its aggressive lugs and well-defined heel-stop design. Between your foot and the Inverness sole is the new EVA StalkAIR 2.0 midsole. This midsole houses a full-length tapered nylon sole plate which offers the perfect lightweight balance of support and feel across soft  medium terrain. The asymmetric tongue design reduces bulk and bunching, increases comfort, and decreases room for water to creep in over the top of the boot. A combination of lightweight fabric lace loops in the lower boot and heavy-duty steel in the upper make sure snugging the boot around your foot shape is easy, and the high ankle support adds major benefits when sidling unstable terrain. title: Hunters Element Spur Shorts - Forest Green - S/32
description: The Spur Shorts are our premium technical hunting shorts. They have been designed to be durable, light, and practical. This light nature is combined with clever design to maximise heat reduction in the hotter months. The three key fabrics used in the body-mapped design work together for ultimate performance. First, Ultra-durable 4-way stretch HYDRAFUSE™ SCRAPEarmour™ fabric is placed on the backside for high abrasion resistance. Next, Lightweight, breathable, quiet and versatile 4-way stretch HYDRAFUSE™ TOUGHSTRETCH™ fabric is placed on the main body for fast wicking and breathability. Finally, tactically placed air-mesh panels in the back of the waist and upper thighs force fresh air to pass over your hot areas as you move, billowing up from the bottom to the top of the shorts. These are RPET fabrics, made from 100% recycled polyethylene terephthalate (Plastic Bottles). This is just as durable as virgin fabric but saves old plastic from ending up in landfill. The clever design means the Spur Shorts feel amazing in the field and the convenience of multiple streamlined pockets means they will become an essential bit of kit for any hunt. title: Hunters Element Odyssey Jacket V2 Forest Green - Small
description: The Legacy is the brainchild of the Hunters Element head product designer. He wanted to create the ultimate mid/outer layer that could be used on just about every hunt. The Legacy was made to keep you warm while glassing and stalking without overheating, as so often happens with membrane-lined outer layers. The purpose-built 290gsm Hydrafuse HYBRIDTECH, RPET recycled fabric uses a 90gsm water-resistant, two-way stretch outer with a 200gsm fleece inner. This means that the jacket is really warm but breathes exceptionally well, all the while remaining quiet, soft and blocking out about 90% of the wind. This RPET fabric is made from 100% recycled polyethylene terephthalate (Plastic Bottles). This is just as durable as virgin fabric but saves 29 bottles from ending up in the landfill. He then took every top-quality feature he could find and packed them into the jacket. This includes high-quality zips, a fold-away TunnelTECH hood, zippered slim-lined chest and lower pockets with hand warmers, and premium cuff adjusters. title: Hunters Element Odyssey Pants V2 Desolve Veil - Small
description: Discover the ultimate all-purpose companion designed to accompany you from forest floors to mountain peaks, enduring whatever challenges nature throws your way. title: Hunters Element Legacy Jacket Black - Small
description: Introducing "The Legacy," born from the visionary mind of Hunters Element's lead product designer. title: Ultra Flex Booties - 5
description: The Ultra Flex Bootie has a low profile, flexible shape with optimized stitching lines for comfort. A simple, hook-and-loop fastener system keeps the Flex Booties firmly attached to your feet even in high-activity watersports, while retaining the high sensitivity that makes this bootie a favorite. The rubber laminated sole provides all the protection you need while maintaining optimum flex for comfort. Features 3mm neoprene Durable, low profile footwear for kayaking, stand up paddling, surfing, rafting, windsurfing, kiteboarding, and sailing Flexible, sensitive sole gives great feedback for technical pursuits Secure Y-pull hook-and-loop fastener strap system Sizing To find out which size you need, we have prepared a simple method to measure your feet, then convert this into the correct bootie size. Please follow the instructions below and check the table for sizing. Measure your foot . Put a piece of paper on a flat surface. Stand on the paper and trace around the perimeter of your foot with a pencil. Measure the length of the outline . Measure from the farthest part at the back to the farthest part at the front; you can do this in inches or centimeters. Measure the width of the outline . Measure from the farthest part at the left to the farthest part at the right; this will usually be at the ball of your foot. Compare these measurements against the chart . For instance, if the outline measured 26 cm long x 10 cm wide, the men's bootie size would be 7 and the women's bootie size would be 8.5 (this would be a really snug fit). Adjust the size depending on use . If you are using the booties for performance sports, use the size you just calculated. For recreational or wetsuit use, go up a size.

title: Nocpix VISTA H35 Thermal Monocular
description: The Nocpix The Vista H35 thermal imaging device impresses with a variety of useful functions and a well-thought-out design. It is extremely compact and therefore perfect for mobile use. A particularly pleasing feature is the noiseless lens cap, which opens and closes quietly. That's just as convincing Nocpix Vista H35 is characterized by outstanding quality and high precision. It combines many advanced functions in a high-quality and user-friendly design and sets new standards in thermal imaging technology. With a high basic magnification and crystal-clear vision, even at long distances, this device is ideal for use in field hunting and forest hunting with a wide field of view. Thanks to an MK value (NEDT value) of <15 mK, the device delivers excellent thermal sensitivity, so that sharp and detailed images are produced even in adverse weather conditions. The IP67 protection class makes the Nocpix Vista H35 is also protected against dust and water, which makes it particularly robust and durable – ideal for use in difficult conditions. Technology that inspires with Vista The Nocpix Vista H35 is clearly designed for hunting in mixed areas. Equipped with a 35 mm lens and a state-of-the-art 640 x 512 px sensor and a pixel pitch of 12 micrometres, it offers excellent image quality. The three-fold basic magnification also contributes to the performance when hunting in mixed areas. The image section is pleasantly large for both field hunting and forest hunting. The field of view of 22 meters is particularly advantageous in the forest or at the feeding station and the basic magnification means that the Vista also delivers extremely good image performance in the field at greater distances. A special feature of the device is the frame rate of 60 Hz, which enables a smooth image display – better than many conventional devices that only offer 50 Hz. The image quality of the Nocpix Vista H35 is truly exceptional and delivers spectacular results. With a weight of 600 g including battery, it may be a little heavier, but the technical features ensure excellent performance that mixed-range hunters will appreciate. Easy operation The device is designed to be pleasingly simple to operate: There is an on/off button, a menu button and two other control buttons. The diopter adjustment on the eyepiece is particularly useful for people who wear glasses. In addition, the eyepiece rubber can be folded back and forth or rotated as required to optimally adjust it for the left and right eye. Underneath the device is the holder for the carrying strap, for which we recommend our Thermal Neckband as a perfect addition. The Nocpix Vista H35 has its own battery system that is designed for up to 6 hours of continuous operation - an impressive performance for a device with an integrated laser rangefinder and 35 mm lens. Image settings for a special user experience New to Nocpix Vista H35 has three image modes: purple, green and red. The green mode is particularly recommended as it is particularly easy on the eyes during long observations. Another useful function is the ability to view captured images directly on the device. With its large AMOLED display and a resolution of 2560×2560 pixels, the Nocpix Vista H35 offers a significantly better image display than many other devices – a real highlight! title: Hunters Element Deluge Jacket - Alpine / S
description: Hunt, work, farm - the toughest jacket ever. What is it? The pinnacle in durability, function and versatility, Deluge is a heavy-duty Nylon waterproof jacket built for abuse, comfort and day-in, day-out performance whether hunting in the mountains or thrashing on the farm. Who is it for? Deluge has been purpose-designed for those wanting hard-wearing durability and versatility in their waterproof jacket. The heavy-duty nylon, yet phenomenal breathability, makes them the ultimate 2-in-1 jacket for rural hunters. Terrain: All-terrain, from farmyard to bush line Season: Autumn/Winter Product Details: The HYDRAFUSE™ NyoSTEEL™ fabric: a heavy-duty nylon outer designed for high abrasion resistance, takes durability to a whole new level, while remaining class-leading in waterproofness and breathability, for maximum comfort. 20,000mm minimum, waterproof rating. 40,000gm/m2/24hr breathability rating. The HYDRAFUSE™ NyoSTEEL™ fabric is resistant to damage from exposure to agricultural chemicals. A cutting-edge waterproof/breathable internal membrane keeps out torrential rain and pumps out internal steam 500D nylon in the highest wear areas and 320D nylon in the highest movement areas. The TunnelTECH™ hood and internal collar provide complete coverage and warmth in southerly downpours. The double storm flapped (with rain gutter), domed YKK® full-length zip means rain and mud don’t stand a chance of getting in. The adjustable cuffs prevent water running down forearms. Packed with four YKK® zipped pockets on the chest and hips for a truckload of storage and easy access Body mapped design: cut to the shape of your body so you have maximum articulation and movement when on the job. Made from recycled nylon: performs the same as virgin nylon but diverts plastic from landfill and ocean. PFC Free DWR (Durable Water Repellent) coating. Giant under-arm pit-zips to dump heat when on the move. Reflective labels for night safety. Weight size M: 1360g Pair the Deluge Jacket with the Deluge Pants

title: LOWA Tibet Evo GTX W - 7 (US 8)
description: Introducing the enhanced Tibet Evo GTX, a rugged companion tailored to the needs of experienced hikers and adept hunters venturing into unforgiving landscapes like Australia's Victorian Alps or New Zealand's Southern Alps. With its revamped rand and outsole design, this robust backpacking boot ensures uncompromising performance in the face of extreme weather conditions, delivering both comfort and protection. Built for 3-4 season performance & ideal for carrying heavy loads of 25kgs+ over long distances. Specs: Last: LOWA Wide Weight: 1760g/pair Nubuck Leather Upper Robust and durable to extend the life of your boots. It is also open pored for breathability while remaining fully waterproof. Gore-Tex® Lining Allows for moisture and sweat to escape while preventing water from entering from the outside. C4 Tongue Reduces pressure on the instep and allows for improved flex and comfort. X-Lacing® Stud Reduces tongue movement and prevents pressure and blisters from forming. Roller Eyelets Allows for quick and easy lacing with minimal friction. Flexfit Allows the foot to roll forward thus saving you strength when going uphill. Also provides for some rotation in an otherwise stiff boot for natural walking comfort. I-Lock System A patented LOWA clamp hook that allows for separate lacing in 2 zones. Once the lacing is tightened in the lower area of the boot, the clamp hook can be used to fix the tightness thus allowing you to customize the support and prevent the laces from becoming loose as you walk. Nylon Stabilizers Provides total underfoot support for rough and uneven terrain so you can go off track with confidence. Polyurethane (PU) Midsole PU midsoles do not deform under heavy packloads so you can carry more without compromising weight and flexibility. SPS System Optimises foot stability to provide added comfort when walking. This system corrects gait by reducing pronation and supination (feet rolling inwards or outwards). Vibram® AppTrail Divo Outsole Experience excellent grip on all surfaces thanks to this self-cleaning mountaineering tread so you can take on rocky and uneven terrain with confidence. Crampon Compatible Obtain better grip in icy conditions. The Tibet is combination crampon compatible. With its revamped rand and outsole design, this robust backpacking boot ensures uncompromising performance in the face of extreme weather conditions, delivering both comfort and protection. Built for 3-4 season performance & ideal for carrying heavy loads of 25kgs+ over long distances. Specs: Last: LOWA Wide Weight: 1760g/pair Nubuck Leather Upper Robust and durable to extend the life of your boots. It is also open pored for breathability while remaining fully waterproof. Gore-Tex® Lining Allows for moisture and sweat to escape while preventing water from entering from the outside. C4 Tongue Reduces pressure on the instep and allows for improved flex and comfort. X-Lacing® Stud Reduces tongue movement and prevents pressure and blisters from forming. Roller Eyelets Allows for quick and easy lacing with minimal friction. Flexfit Allows the foot to roll forward thus saving you strength when going uphill. Also provides for some rotation in an otherwise stiff boot for natural walking comfort. I-Lock System A patented LOWA clamp hook that allows for separate lacing in 2 zones. Once the lacing is tightened in the lower area of the boot, the clamp hook can be used to fix the tightness thus allowing you to customize the support and prevent the laces from becoming loose as you walk. Nylon Stabilizers Provides total underfoot support for rough and uneven terrain so you can go off track with confidence. Polyurethane (PU) Midsole PU midsoles do not deform under heavy packloads so you can carry more without compromising weight and flexibility. SPS System Optimises foot stability to provide added comfort when walking. This system corrects gait by reducing pronation and supination (feet rolling inwards or outwards). Vibram® AppTrail Divo Outsole Experience excellent grip on all surfaces thanks to this self-cleaning mountaineering tread so you can take on rocky and uneven terrain with confidence. Crampon Compatible Obtain better grip in icy conditions. The Tibet is combination crampon compatible. And we guarantee you'll be able to go further and explore more.

title: Nocpix QUEST LRF L35R Thermal Binocular
description: ONE-HAND OPERATION Users can observe with one hand, freeing the other hand to drive, just like using traditional binoculars. Middle-positioned zoom lever, easy to operate. The zoom lever can be adjusted by only one finger even with gloves. The number of buttons on the device has been reduced from six to four, allowing users to more easily achieve focus, zoom, and range measurement with just two fingers. ERGONOMIC DESIGN Ergonomic design enhances comfort and usability. Carefully crafted shape and grip, resembling traditional binocular designs, ensure a comfortable hold. Suitable for prolonged use without discomfort, ideal for casual users and outdoor enthusiasm. Compact and Lightweight Enhance comfort during long observation sessions by reducing strain on the shoulders and neck, allowing hunters to focus for extended periods. 700g lightweight and the size of 175.4*138*66mm. Internal magnesium alloy structure and outer silicon shell make it compact and light, making one hand operation easier. ROUND DISPLAY Comfortable viewing experience, ideal for extended use. AMOLED 1920×1200, 0.72inch Round Display screen brings users immersive experience just like traditional binoculars. 60Hz frame rate can provide smoother image display, reducing stuttering or lag, and enhancing the user’s observation experience during fast movement, making it closer to that of traditional optical binoculars. F0.9 Lens Comparing to normal F1.0 lens, the F0.9 lens(Quest H35R/Quest L35R) could gain 20% more light intake and significantly improve image quality. High Sensitivity Thermal Core The QUEST series is equipped with a self-developed sensor with NETD ≤15mK, ensuring high sensitivity to temperature differences and delivering highly detailed imaging output. Reality+ Image Improvement AI Algorithms Reality+ utilizes industry-leading deep convolutional neural network technology, supported by a vast training dataset far exceeding average standards, ensuring absolute precision of the algorithm. This technology automatically enhances image details, removes noise and interference from infrared images, and avoids the over-smoothing issues common in traditional denoising techniques, preserving intricate details down to every strand of fur on animals, achieving a significant leap in image quality. Objective Lens Diameter 35mm Angular Field of View 7.5 x 5.5° Sensor Size 384px Pixel Pitch 12 μm NETD <15 mK Maximum Detection Range 1800m Display Type AMOLED Display Size 1920x1200 Optical Magnification 5x Battery 18650 Length 175mm Weight 700 grams

title: LOWA Renegade Evo GTX® Mid Wide - 7 (US 8)

title: Hunters Element Legacy Jacket - Women's - 6
description: The Legacy is the brainchild of the Hunters Element head product designer. He wanted to create the ultimate mid/outer layer that could be used on just about every hunt. The Legacy was made to keep you warm while glassing and stalking without overheating, as so often happens with membrane lined outer layers. He then took every top-quality feature he could find and packed them into the jacket. title: HIKMICRO HABROK 4K HQ35L 35mm 640x512 12mic <20mK NV 850nm Binoculars with LRF
description: HIKMICRO HQ35L 4K Habrok – Multispectral Thermal Binoculars for Day and Night Precision The HIKMICRO HQ35L 4K is a next-generation multispectral binocular built for hunters, pest controllers, and outdoor professionals. It blends high-end thermal imaging , 4K optical clarity, and night vision into one rugged, versatile device. Whether you are scanning open farmland, tracking movement in dense bush, or monitoring property boundaries, the Habrok HQ35L 4K delivers dependable performance in any light. With premium sensors, smart features, and tough construction, this binocular is designed to perform when it matters most. Thermal Imaging That Sees What Others Miss The HQ35L 4K features a 640 × 512 VOx thermal sensor with a sensitivity rating of <20 mK NETD. This high level of sensitivity detects even subtle heat differences from animals, people, or equipment. You can operate in total darkness, heavy fog, or light rain without losing image detail. A bright F1.0 35 mm lens pushes detection range out to 1,800 m. The 50 Hz refresh rate keeps panning smooth and movement natural. Long hours of scanning feel comfortable, with clear and stable thermal imagery. 4K Day and Night Optical Clarity The Habrok HQ35L 4K adds a second optical channel for true 4K (3840 × 2160) imaging. Daytime views are bright, colourful, and sharp across the entire field of view. At night, the sensor boosts low-light performance for improved detail and target recognition. Built-in infrared illuminators extend viewing distance beyond what the eye can see. This dual-channel setup removes the need to carry separate day and night optics. Switch between modes instantly, without changing your grip or losing sight of the target. Dual IR Illuminators for Night Vision Flexibility The HQ35L 4K comes with two infrared illuminators. The 850 nm version provides maximum range for spotting at distance. The 940 nm option offers stealth, staying nearly invisible to wildlife or people. Swap between illuminators to match your environment and purpose. Laser Rangefinder for Accurate Distance Measurement A built-in laser rangefinder measures distances out to 1,000 m with ±1 m accuracy. For farmers and pest controllers, that means knowing exactly how far away an animal is before you move. Quick distance readings are also useful for search and rescue or security work. Smooth Zoom and Image Stability Zoom Pro technology keeps image quality high even when magnifying. Magnification ranges from 5.5× to 22×, covering close observation through to long-range spotting. Electronic image stabilisation reduces the effects of hand movement. Built for Harsh Outdoor Conditions The Habrok HQ35L 4K uses a magnesium alloy chassis for strength and durability. It is sealed to an IP67 rating, making it waterproof and dustproof. It operates in extreme temperatures from –30 °C to +55 °C. The design withstands bumps, knocks, and rough field handling. All-Day Power and Smart Connectivity Two replaceable 18650 batteries power the device for over eight hours. Charging is simple with USB-C. A generous 64 GB of internal storage holds many hours of video and images. Built-in Wi-Fi allows streaming to a mobile device and easy sharing of footage. Feature-Rich for Maximum Field Efficiency The HQ35L 4K includes Picture-in-Picture mode for improved focus on small targets. Hotspot detection highlights the hottest part of the image automatically. Hot-Track follows moving heat signatures across the display. GPS and a digital compass assist with navigation in remote areas. These features combine to make observation faster, easier, and more accurate. Key Specifications Thermal Sensor 640 × 512 VOx, <20 mK NETD Thermal Lens 35 mm F1.0 Optical Sensor 4K (3840 × 2160) Magnification 5.5×–22× IR Illuminators 850 nm & 940 nm Rangefinder 1,000 m, ±1 m Display 0.49" OLED, 1920 × 1080 Storage 64 GB Protection IP67 Weight ~798 g (without batteries) Runtime 8+ hours Why the HIKMICRO HQ35L 4K Habrok is the Right Choice This binocular offers more than just vision — it delivers situational awareness. Hunters can scan large areas in thermal, switch to optical for detail, and confirm distances instantly. Pest controllers gain a single, portable solution for night and day work. Search and rescue teams can locate people quickly, even in poor visibility. The Habrok HQ35L 4K is easy to carry, simple to use, and built to last. If you need one device to do it all, this is the solution.

title: HIKMICRO Lynx LE15 3.0 Thermal Monocular
description: The HIKMICRO Lynx LE15 3.0 is a compact, high-performance thermal monocular designed to deliver reliable detection and crystal-clear imaging in any light or weather condition. Built for hunters, wildlife observers, and outdoor professionals, it combines advanced thermal technology with a lightweight, pocket-sized design for effortless field use. Powered by a 256 × 192 high-sensitivity thermal sensor and a 15mm F1.0 lens , the LE15 3.0 provides sharp thermal imagery with a detection range of up to 750 metres , allowing you to spot heat signatures long before they become visible to the naked eye. Its AI-driven Image Pro 3.0 and Zoom Pro algorithms enhance detail, contrast, and clarity, ensuring accurate identification across a range of environments. Designed for smooth, uninterrupted viewing, the device features HIKMICRO’s shutterless HSIS technology , eliminating image freezing and delivering fluid, noise-free visuals—ideal for discreet observation and tracking. The 1024 × 768 AMOLED display further enhances image quality with vibrant contrast and comfortable long-term viewing. Despite its powerful performance, the Lynx LE15 3.0 remains incredibly portable, weighing just under 300g , making it perfect for extended use in the field. A replaceable 18650 battery provides up to 5.5 hours of continuous operation , ensuring dependable performance during long sessions outdoors. With built-in photo and video recording , Wi-Fi connectivity via the HIKMICRO Sight app, and an IP67-rated rugged design , the LE15 3.0 is built to perform in demanding conditions while keeping you connected and in control. Key Features: 256 × 192 thermal sensor with <20 mK sensitivity 15mm F1.0 lens with up to 750m detection range Image Pro 3.0 & Zoom Pro AI image enhancement HSIS shutterless system for smooth viewing 1024 × 768 AMOLED display Built-in recording & 64GB storage Wi-Fi connectivity with mobile app integration Lightweight (≈296g) and IP67 weatherproof

title: ThermTec Ventus 635L Multi-Spectrum Thermal Binoculars
description: ThermTec Ventus 635L – Multi-Spectrum Thermal Binoculars The ThermTec Ventus 635L puts thermal, 4K digital day vision, dual-band infrared night vision and a laser rangefinder in one binocular body. Scanning the paddock at last light, checking the bush edge at midnight or watching wildlife at dawn, it covers the lot without swapping devices. The core is a 640×512 VOx thermal sensor with NETD of ≤15 mK, so it picks up small temperature differences between an animal and its surroundings, even on cold, damp nights. Paired with a fast 35mm F0.9 germanium lens, ThermTec quotes detection out to 1,800 metres. Thermal + Digital + Night Vision in One Device Alongside the thermal channel sits a 12-megapixel 4K CMOS sensor with its own 50mm lens, giving full-colour imagery during the day. As light fades, switchable IR illumination at 850nm (for range) or 940nm (near-invisible to animals) turns it into a night vision binocular. Picture-in-picture overlays thermal onto the digital image, so you can pick up heat through scrub and still see the terrain and species detail around it. Built-In Laser Rangefinder to 1,000 Metres The integrated rangefinder reads out to 1,000 metres with ±1m accuracy. Find the heat signature, confirm what it is on the digital channel and range it, all without lowering the binoculars. The LRF sits in the front objective, and closing the lens cap keeps dust off it. Display & AI Image Processing The 0.5-inch AMOLED display runs at 1600×1200 with deep blacks and strong contrast. ThermTec's AI Thermal Super Resolution keeps detail in check through digital zoom up to 14.8×, handy when you're trying to tell a fox from a cat on the far fence line. Comfortable for Long Sessions It's a true binocular, not a bi-ocular, so you view with both eyes and tire less over a long night. The rubberised housing stays grippy in wet or cold conditions, dual focus wheels work with either hand, and interpupillary distance adjusts from 60–72mm. Practical Field Features 6+ hours battery life from dual 18650 cells (standard and widely available) Proximity sensor sleeps the display when you lower it, extending runtime 64GB internal storage for photo and video recording Wi-Fi for live streaming and file transfer via the ThermTec app (iOS & Android) IP67 rated for dust and water resistance ThermTec Ventus 635L Technical Specifications Thermal Sensor 640 × 512 px, VOx, 12µm pitch Thermal Sensitivity (NETD) ≤15 mK Thermal Lens 35mm F0.9 Germanium CMOS Sensor 12MP (3536 × 3536 px) 4K UHD Digital/NV Lens 50mm IR Illumination Switchable 850nm / 940nm (detachable) Laser Rangefinder Up to 1,000m (±1m accuracy) Detection Range Up to 1,800m Display 0.5" AMOLED, 1600 × 1200 px Base Magnification 2.6× Digital Zoom Up to 14.8× (AI Super Resolution) Field of View 12.5° (21.9m at 100m) Frame Rate 50 Hz Battery 2× 18650 Li-ion (included) Battery Life Up to 6 hours Internal Storage 64GB Interpupillary Distance 60–72mm Weight 825g Water/Dust Rating IP67 Who Is the Ventus 635L For? Farmers, property managers, pest controllers and wildlife watchers who want one observation device instead of separate thermal, night vision and rangefinder units. The wider 12.5° field of view and lower 2.6× base magnification suit bush and mixed country; if you mostly glass wide open ground, have a look at the Ventus 650L. Not sure which suits your country? Get in touch and we'll tell you straight. Frequently Asked Questions – ThermTec Ventus 635L How far can the ThermTec Ventus 635L detect? ThermTec quotes a maximum thermal detection range of 1,800 metres for human-sized heat signatures. The laser rangefinder measures to 1,000 metres with ±1m accuracy. Real-world identification distance depends on the animal, weather and terrain. Can the ThermTec Ventus 635L record video? Yes. It has 64GB of internal storage for photos and video, plus Wi-Fi for live streaming and file transfer via the ThermTec app on iOS and Android. What batteries does the ThermTec Ventus 635L use? Two standard 18650 lithium-ion rechargeable batteries (included), giving up to 6 hours of continuous use. 18650 cells are easy to find, so carrying spares is simple. Is the ThermTec Ventus 635L waterproof? It carries an IP67 rating: dust-tight and able to handle temporary immersion up to 1 metre for 30 minutes, so rain and creek crossings are no drama.

title: ThermTec Ventus 650L Multi-Spectrum Thermal Binoculars
description: ThermTec Ventus 650L – Long-Range Multi-Spectrum Thermal Binoculars The ThermTec Ventus 650L is the long-range model in the Ventus series: thermal, 4K digital day vision, dual-band infrared night vision and a laser rangefinder in one binocular. Its bigger 50mm F1.0 germanium thermal lens pushes ThermTec's quoted detection range out to 2,600 metres, built for open paddocks, broad valleys and big stations. 640×512 Thermal Sensor with ≤15 mK Sensitivity It runs the same 640×512 VOx sensor (12µm, NETD ≤15 mK) as the 635L, so faint temperature differences still stand out on cold, damp nights. The larger lens gathers more thermal energy, taking detection from 1,800m on the 635L to 2,600m. Thermal + 4K Digital + Night Vision in One Device A 12-megapixel 4K CMOS sensor with a 50mm lens gives full-colour daytime imagery. After dark, switchable IR at 850nm (to 400m) or 940nm (near-invisible to animals, to 350m) turns it into a night vision binocular. The detachable illuminator switches wavelength with a lever underneath, so there's no menu diving in the dark. Picture-in-picture overlays thermal onto the digital image so you see heat and terrain together. Built-In Laser Rangefinder to 1,000 Metres Range out to 1,000 metres with ±1m accuracy without lowering the binoculars. The LRF sits in the front objective housing, and the lens cap keeps dust off it. EIS Stabilisation, GPS & Compass The 650L adds three things the 635L doesn't have. Electronic Image Stabilisation steadies the view at higher magnification, where hand shake shows most. GPS with a digital compass and azimuth display tracks where you are and which way you're looking, and hot-spot tracking locks onto the warmest object in frame. That's handy for large-area pest and wildlife surveys. AI Super Resolution (KI-ZOOM-PRO) holds detail through digital zoom up to 14.8×, viewed on a 0.5-inch 1600×1200 AMOLED. Comfortable for Long Sessions True two-eye binocular viewing means less fatigue over a long night. The rubberised housing stays grippy wet or cold, dual focus wheels work with either hand, interpupillary distance adjusts 60–72mm and dioptre ±5. Practical Field Features 6+ hours battery life from dual 18650 cells Proximity sensor sleeps the display when lowered 64GB internal storage for photo and video Wi-Fi streaming and file transfer via the ThermTec app (iOS & Android) IP67 rated for dust and water resistance ThermTec Ventus 650L Technical Specifications Thermal Sensor 640 × 512 px, VOx, 12µm pitch Thermal Sensitivity (NETD) ≤15 mK Thermal Lens 50mm F1.0 Germanium CMOS Sensor 12MP (3536 × 3536 px) 4K UHD Digital/NV Lens 50mm F1.4 IR Illumination Switchable 850nm (400m) / 940nm (350m), detachable Laser Rangefinder Up to 1,000m (±1m accuracy) Detection Range Up to 2,600m Display 0.5" AMOLED, 1600 × 1200 px Base Magnification 3.7× Digital Zoom Up to 14.8× (AI Super Resolution / KI-ZOOM-PRO) Optical Zoom (Digital Channel) 4× to 16× Field of View 8.8° (15.4m at 100m) Frame Rate 50 Hz Image Stabilisation EIS (Electronic Image Stabilisation) Battery 2× 18650 Li-ion (included) Battery Life Up to 6 hours Internal Storage 64GB GPS Yes, with digital compass & azimuth Interpupillary Distance 60–72mm Dioptre Adjustment ±5 dpt Dimensions 164 × 127.6 × 73mm Weight 833g Water/Dust Rating IP67 Ventus 650L or 635L? Same sensor, display, LRF and multi-spectrum setup; the difference is the thermal lens. The 635L (35mm, 2.6×, 12.5° field of view, 1,800m) suits bush and mixed country. The 650L (50mm F1.0, 3.7×, 8.8°, 2,600m) is for open country, plus EIS, GPS and compass. Stuck between the two? Get in touch and we'll point you to the right one for your property. Frequently Asked Questions – ThermTec Ventus 650L How far can the ThermTec Ventus 650L detect? ThermTec quotes a maximum thermal detection range of 2,600 metres for human-sized heat signatures, with laser ranging to 1,000 metres (±1m). Real-world identification distance depends on the animal, weather and terrain. Does the ThermTec Ventus 650L have image stabilisation and GPS? Yes. It has Electronic Image Stabilisation, plus GPS with a digital magnetic compass and azimuth display. GPS coordinates are embedded in recordings when the GPS module is active. What batteries does the ThermTec Ventus 650L use? Two standard 18650 lithium-ion rechargeable batteries (included), giving up to 6 hours of continuous use.

title: HIKMICRO HABROK 4K HE25L 2.0 – Multi-spectrum Binoculars
description: Born from the field, built for the future. HABROK 4K 2.0 combines cutting-edge shutterless thermal technology, 4K digital vivid images, superior clarity in darkness with lR, and intuitive ergonomics in one compact device. Whether you stalk in twilight, scan open fields, or track through dense woods, HABROK 4K 2.0 ensures you never miss a moment that matters. HABROK 4K 2.0 is a step into digital observation without giving up the familiar binocular feel. Rear Focus with T/D Switcher: From Target to Detail, One Smooth Motion The redesigned HABROK 4K 2.0 adds a dedicated Thermal/Digital Switcher to help toggle between two channels seamlessly, and places the focus wheel in the rear for one-handed operation and rapid adjustments — an intuitive design inspired by traditional binoculars, but made smarter. Quick Scan and Search with HIKMICRO Advanced Thermal Detector Experience unmatched detection power with <18mK NETD sensitivity, HIKMICRO’s Zoom Pro algorithm, SyncPro and Shutterless Technology from HABROK 4K 2.0 for uninterrupted, fluid viewing. Every heat signature stands out with remarkable contrast, even through brushes or leaves, from dawn mist to moonless nights. Spot, identify, and track game faster and further than ever before. High-Tech 4K Detector Delivers Vivid Images Even at Twilight The high-tech 4K CMOS sensor captures stunning detail and natural colors, preserving the authenticity of every scene. Especially at twilight, the Multi-Spectrum Binocular HABROK 4K 2.0 keeps your view sharp and vivid when optical devices start to fade — providing the extra few minutes you need on a hunt. Built-in Laser Rangefinder for Accurate Distance Measurement The integrated laser rangefinder in the HIKMICRO HABROK 4K 2.0 determines accurate distances up to a maximum of 1,000m with a ±1 meter accuracy. Smooth Zoom, Steady Vision, Always in Control When your target is moving, distance and precision shift every second. With updated image stabilization algorithms in both thermal and digital channels and unrestricted zoom in and out function, HIKMICRO HABROK 4K 2.0 lets you track and identify with confidence through every zoom level, wherever the night takes you. Customize your preferred zoom step (2x, 3x, 4x, or 5x) to suit how you like to scan. Range Readout at a Glance Measure the distance and the reading sits right in the display, so you can log how far that fox or mob of roos is without lowering the binoculars or reaching for a separate rangefinder. Highlights Capturing in Local Album and APP With the Multi-Spectrum Binocular HABROK 4K 2.0, you are able to create photos and videos for sharing the experience, reviewing what you spotted, or reliving the excitement. Your exciting highlights are stored directly in Local Album and can be shared to smartphone by connecting SIGHT APP*. Long Operation Time, Enough for A Full Day Hunting HABROK 4K 2.0 comes with four 18650 replaceable and rechargeable batteries, providing 6.5-hour① continuous operation on a single charge. Plus Smart Standby Mode saves power the moment you lower the device -- enjoy the hunt without power anxiety. Ergonomic Comfort, Allows You Stay in the Moment Every detail is designed for comfort and focus. HIKMICRO HABROK 4K 2.0's 60-74mm adjustable interpupillary distance and the 0.49'' 1920x1080 large OLED display offer comfort that keeps you connected to every moment of the hunt, while the foldable eyecups make it just as comfortable for hunters who wear glasses. Lightweight but Rugged, Ready for Any Challenge At only 895g (without battery), the Multi-Spectrum Binocular HABROK 4K 2.0 strikes the perfect balance between strength and agility. Built to perform in freezing mornings to sudden rain or a fall in the mud — it staying reliable even when nature turns unpredictable.

title: Pulsar Telos LRF XT50 Thermal Monocular
description: Need: Highest-detail Telos spotting with laser rangefinding when you need to identify an animal and know exactly how far away it is. Consider: XT50 1280 vs XP50 640 — resolution and LRF vs weight/cost of capability. The Pulsar Telos LRF XT50 is the top of the Telos range: a 1280×1024 thermal sensor, a fast F50/1.0 lens and a built-in 1,200 m laser rangefinder in one upgradeable handheld. If you want the most detail Telos offers and an exact distance without reaching for a second device, this is the one. It suits long nights checking stock, scanning boundary fences, watching wildlife or working out what that heat signature on the far ridge actually is. Pulsar Telos LRF XT50 at a glance 1280×1024 HD thermal sensor with 12 µm pixel pitch Fast F50/1.0 objective lens 2–16× magnification with Zoom Boost up to 24× 2,300 m manufacturer-stated thermal detection range Integrated laser rangefinder measuring up to 1,200 m 1920×1080 AMOLED HD display 128 GB internal photo and video storage IPX7 waterproof rating Detail and a wide view at the same time The 1280×1024 sensor runs at 50 Hz, and the F50/1.0 lens gives a 17.5° horizontal field of view (30.7 m at 100 m). That means you can sweep a paddock quickly, then zoom in from 2× to 16× (24× with Zoom Boost) and still have plenty of pixels to work with. Pulsar quotes detection up to 2,300 m; that's detecting a heat source, not identifying it, so real results depend on the animal, weather and terrain. Range it without lowering it The built-in 905 nm Class 1 laser rangefinder reads out to 1,200 m with ±1 m accuracy, so you know exactly how far away that mob of roos or wandering bull is, straight from the eyepiece. Comfortable for long sessions The 1920×1080 AMOLED display has −5 to +4 dioptre adjustment and 13 mm eye relief, with nine colour palettes to choose from. Controls are ambidextrous, focus and zoom rings sit up front so you can adjust by feel, and the body is IPX7 rated for −25°C to +40°C. It measures 242×72×77 mm and weighs 0.73 kg. Record, connect and power up Photos and video record at 1440×1080 (JPG/MP4) to 128 GB of built-in memory. Dual-band Wi-Fi and BLE 5.0 link to the Stream Vision 2 app. The replaceable LPS 7i battery (6400 mAh) is rated for up to 8 hours at 22°C, with 5 V / 9 V USB Type-C Power Delivery for external power. Built to be upgraded Telos is Pulsar's upgradeable line, with sensor and objective-lens upgrades among the listed options. What's available, and when, is up to Pulsar and can vary by market, so ask us before you buy if that matters to you. Pulsar Telos LRF XT50 specifications Thermal sensor Sensor type Uncooled microbolometer Sensor resolution 1280×1024 pixels Pixel pitch 12 µm Sensor NETD <40 mK System NETD <20 mK Frame rate 50 Hz Optics and display Objective lens F50/1.0 Magnification 2–16×; Zoom Boost to 24× Horizontal field of view 17.5°; 30.7 m at 100 m Dioptre adjustment −5 / +4 D Eye relief 13 mm Display 1920×1080 AMOLED HD Detection and ranging Thermal detection range Up to 2,300 m Laser rangefinder Up to 1,200 m; ±1 m accuracy Laser specification 905 nm; IEC 60825-1:2014 Class 1 Recording and connectivity Photo/video resolution 1440×1080 pixels File formats MP4 / JPG Built-in memory 128 GB Bluetooth BLE 5.0 Wi-Fi IEEE 802.11 b/g/n/ac (WPA); 2.4/5 GHz Supported apps Stream Vision 2 Power, construction and dimensions Battery Replaceable LPS 7i Li-ion, 6400 mAh Manufacturer-stated runtime 8 hours at 22°C External power 5 V / 9 V USB Type-C Power Delivery Waterproof rating IPX7 Operating temperature −25°C to +40°C Tripod adaptor Adaptor for ¼-inch Body material Plastic Dimensions 242×72×77 mm Weight 0.73 kg Manufacturer SKU 77524 Pulsar Telos LRF XT50 FAQs How far can the Telos LRF XT50 detect? Pulsar states up to 2,300 m. Detection isn't identification, and real-world results depend on the target and conditions. Is the XT50 waterproof? Yes. It's rated IPX7 under IEC 60529 and specified for −25°C to +40°C. Manufacturer information: detection distance, rangefinder distance and battery runtime are stated maximums under specified conditions. Real-world performance can vary. title: Nocpix Omni H35R Multi Spectral Thermal Binoculars
description: Good for Need Fit Why Day & twilight ●●● 8K camera + 850/940 nm IR Close country & scrub ●●○ 12.5° thermal field of view Long-range ID ●●○ 640×512 sensor, 35 mm lens Laser ranging ●●○ Ranging fitted ●●● Excellent · ●●○ Very good · ●○○ Good Compare: Thermal binoculars · Nocpix thermal range Nocpix OMNI H35R: The World's First 8K Multi-Spectrum Thermal Binocular The Nocpix OMNI H35R is the world's first multi-spectrum binocular with an 8K digital sensor, which captures over four times the pixels of mainstream 4K sensors. It combines that digital channel with Nocpix's self-developed 640×512 thermal detector (NETD ≤15 mK), image stabilisation, ranging and connectivity. For all-day observation across Australia, from bright mornings through twilight to full dark, the OMNI H35R is one binocular for every light. Higher Recognition with 8K Detail The 8K sensor keeps finer detail at high magnification for more accurate target recognition. Three scene-specific algorithms (Daylight, Twilight and Low-Light) optimise the image, and the F1.8 50 mm lens gathers more light in challenging conditions. Faster Detection with Thermal Clarity The 640×512, 12 µm thermal sensor at 50 Hz, behind a 35 mm F0.9 lens, cuts noise and boosts sensitivity for richer detail and clearer targets. One-Motion Operation and Stable Viewing One press switches between the digital and thermal channels, and a focus ring underneath sits at the fingertips. Electronic stabilisation works from 1×, zoom moves in 0.5× steps, and a 12 mm exit pupil with a 0.5-inch 1600×1200 AMOLED keeps viewing comfortable. Fast-Ready Power and Dual IR Emitters A polarity-free 18650 bay allows quick battery swaps, even in the dark. Two detachable IR emitters let the user choose 850 nm for range or 940 nm for discretion, and Bluetooth plus N-Link connect the OMNI to the Nocpix app and other Nocpix devices. A magnesium-alloy body and a built-in tripod socket complete it.
